import Mathlib

theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hq' : (q : ℝ) * q = 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hs : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = (2 : ℝ) := by
    simpa using (Real.mul_self_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num))
  rcases le_total (q : ℝ) (Real.sqrt 2) with hle | hle
  · have h : (q : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)]
    exact irrational_sqrt_two ⟨q, h.symm⟩
  · have h : (q : ℝ) = -Real.sqrt 2 := by
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)]
    have h' : ((-q : ℚ) : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
      norm_num [h]
    exact irrational_sqrt_two ⟨-q, h'.symm⟩
